display_name: Income Tax Ordinance s 164 and the Income Tax (Deduction from Salary and Wages) Regulations 5753-1993: how much an employer deducts from a monthly salary (Schedule A), the maximal-rate routes, a non-regular salary, and what the employee may claim

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md; policy SHRUG (Meng, 2026-10-08) for every ambiguity

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Hebrew is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the deposited source, and in short runs checked to occur verbatim in it (tools/hebcheck.py).

sources.authority: aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation; s 164 is lines 5322-5323
aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation (revision 2987411), amended to 5785-2025

vendored: VENDORED.txt: four modules of row IL-03 v0.3.0, byte-for-byte, with sha256

published_figures.note: Not law. Two figures the Israel Tax Authority published, carried from rows IL-01 and IL-03 (not re-read from the PDFs by this row) in ito-il26-published-figures.l4 and passed through s 120B(e)(1) to 2026 and 2027. No rule reads them; the rules take them as the argument `The annual figures for the tax year`.

scope: Encoded: ITO s 164 (the duty, the ten kinds of payment, the State as payer, the instrument for employment income); Regulations 5753-1993 regs 1 (the definitions the deduction turns on), 2(a),(c), 3(a)-(b), 4(a),(c), 5(a)-(e), 9(a),(c), 10, and Schedule A items (1)-(5) in full; item (6) and the cumulative method refused by name. Passed through, not re-encoded: ss 120B, 121, 121B (row IL-03). Refused by name or out of scope, with reasons in NOTES.md section 2: regs 3(c)-(d) with Schedules B and C, 4(b), 6, 7, 8, 11-15, and every kind of payment in s 164 other than employment income.
tax_years_answered: 2026, 2027 (the years IL-03 prints section 121 for); every other year is declined by IL-03's refusals

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent test pass has been run. Every expected value was worked by hand from the text before it was run.

forks.F1: Schedule A items (2)-(3): whether credit points are set off against the s 121B additional tax. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), a switch; default declined where the readings part.
forks.F2: Schedule A item (5): whether the salary is rounded before item (1) multiplies it. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), a switch; default declined where the readings part.
forks.F3: Regulation 3(b): whether the share of the tax on a part is rounded. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), a switch; default declined where the readings part.
forks.F4: Schedule A item (2): whether a salary paid in one tax year for another is deducted by the amounts of the year of payment or of the work. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), a switch; default declined where the readings part.
forks.F5: Regulation 4(a): the difference of tax is tax(S plus B/12) less tax(S), each the rounded Schedule A figure. Classed (b): one arguable reading, no switch.
forks.F6: Regulation 1 'maximal rate' is the s 121 top rate, 47%, without the s 121B surtax. Classed (b).
forks.F7: A deduction at the maximal rate is not rounded. Classed (b); assumption A2.
forks.F8: Regulation 5 (partial salary) is tested before regulation 3(c) (day employee). Classed (b).
forks.F9: A form 0130 declaration does not lift the maximal rate on a declared additional position. Classed (b).
